description: Hold a document open with the given text, as an editor buffer the server analyzes instead of the file on disk, so text can be checked (diagnostics, hover, render) before it is written. Nothing is written to disk; close_document reverts to the file. format, rename and apply_model_edit with apply=true write the buffer, unless the file changed on disk since it was opened. Returns the diagnostics of the text.

path.description: the document, absolute or relative to the workspace root; it need not exist on disk yet

text.description: the full text to hold as the document's content

name: open_document

diagnostics.description: the diagnostics of the text now held

code.description: the stable identifier of the check

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

source.description: the pass that produced the diagnostic

open.description: whether the server now holds an open buffer for the document

version.description: the buffer's version, incremented by each update
